My Online Shopping Experience: 分享网购经历与心态变化的独白。
I used to dislike shopping, especially in crowded malls.
column3: 我以前不喜欢购物,尤其是在拥挤的商场。

My Online Shopping Experience: Then a friend introduced me to online shopping.
column3: 后来一位朋友向我介绍了网购。

My Online Shopping Experience: At first, I worried about the quality of the products.
So I only bought cheap things like books and socks.
column3: 所以只买书和袜子这类便宜的东西。

My Online Shopping Experience: Gradually, I learned to read reviews carefully.
column3: 渐渐地,我学会了仔细看评价。

My Online Shopping Experience: Now I check both the good and bad comments before paying.
column3: 现在付款前我会把好评差评都看一遍。

My Online Shopping Experience: Last month, I even bought my phone online.
column3: 上个月我连手机都在网上买了。

My Online Shopping Experience: It arrived in two days and works perfectly.
column3: 两天就送到了,用着非常好。

My Online Shopping Experience: Online shopping saves me time and energy.
column3: 网购为我节省了时间和精力。

My Online Shopping Experience: Still, I never spend more than my budget allows.
column3: 不过我从不超出预算消费。
